tools.name: fathom_find
tools.description: Find public places and synthetic groups for an interest in a town. Read-only. Pass your person's memory link as memory to put what fits them first.

tools.name: activities_request_to_join
tools.description: Ask to join an activity for your person, only after they said they want to. It asks to join the activity, all its dates, not one evening. Give your person the undoUrl: it is their own page for this request, and Withdraw is there. Keep it for them; the status URL alone can't take the request back.

tools.name: fathom_status
tools.description: Read a proposal, join request, or your person's own memory by its link, given exactly as your person has it. Read-only.

tools.name: fathom_propose
tools.description: Only after your person said yes to this exact proposal. Propose a missing place or community, or (kind offer) your person's own spare capacity. A place needs a source: any https page about it that you read, your person gave you, or Fathom listed. It returns an undoUrl; give your person the undoUrl:

tools.name: fathom_remember
tools.description: Keep how your person likes to meet, choices only, only after your person said yes to being remembered (send keep: "yes"). Give them the private link it returns.

tools.name: fathom_forget
tools.description: Forget a memory for good when your person asks, using their own link exactly as they have it.

tools.name: fathom_space_join
tools.description: Join a builder's private Space for your person through their invite link, only after your person said yes to joining. Returns their own token for activities_tick_choice and fathom_space.

tools.name: fathom_space_context
tools.description: Add one fact to a Space you built: with the https page that states it, or synthetic: "yes" when made up for the plan.

tools.name: fathom_space
tools.description: Read a private Space as its members see it.

tools.name: fathom_builder_start
tools.description: Start a builder sandbox with a synthetic Space and activity.

tools.name: fathom_help
tools.description: Read the full current guidance for a Fathom tool.

tools.name: platform_describe
tools.description: Describe Fathom and its safe synthetic lab boundary.

tools.name: capabilities_search
tools.description: Search the available synthetic capability catalog.

tools.name: spaces_create_draft
tools.description: Create a synthetic draft Space for the delegated principal.

tools.name: spaces_get
tools.description: Read a Space when its visibility rules allow it.

tools.name: spaces_list_public
tools.description: List public synthetic Spaces visible to the caller.

tools.name: places_verdicts
tools.description: Read the person's own private place answers.

tools.name: affiliations_declare
tools.description: Say how interests relate (serves, kind-of, part-of, alias-of). It lands as recommended: never used or shown to members until the steward approves it. Terms are plain text, never a person.

tools.name: genesis_items
tools.description: Read the places and activities a genesis run found, from position since. Relay the attribution lines and the unclaimed line exactly as returned, and keep each place's source link next to its name.

tools.name: knowledge_lens
tools.description: Answer 'where can I … in <town>' with sourced places. Relay the attribution lines and the unclaimed line exactly as returned. When you pass a place on to your person, keep its source link next to its name, so they can see where it comes from.

tools.name: propose_type
tools.description: Propose a data-only kind or predicate the knowledge layer lacks; it answers "use X" when one exists. Examples that are people, and kinds named for a person or role, are refused.

tools.name: type_status
tools.description: Read a kind or predicate's status and evidence.

tools.name: extensions_report_gap
tools.description: Report a missing capability and why it matters.

tools.name: extensions_propose
tools.description: Propose a strict data-only ability; it stays pending until a steward reviews it. The id must not name a town: abilities work in every town; where they apply is data.

tools.name: extensions_list
tools.description: List approved extensions and your own proposals.

tools.name: extensions_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw your proposed extension before steward review.

tools.name: views_propose
tools.description: Propose a bounded synthetic-place view for steward review.

tools.name: views_checks
tools.description: Run the steward checks for a view trial.

tools.name: views_list
tools.description: List approved and your own proposed views.

tools.name: activities_set_details
tools.description: Attach validated extension values to an activity.

tools.name: activities_add
tools.description: Add a synthetic activity to a Space as its owner. Only a person can mark one real.

tools.name: activities_list_join_requests
tools.description: List join requests for the owner or requester.

tools.name: activities_answer
tools.description: Refused for AIs: a person's answer to an activity is theirs alone, given on the people page. Tell your person what activities_participation shows; never answer for them.

tools.name: activities_participation
tools.description: Read the person's activity answer, places and offers. ifOthersCount ("N would come if others say they're in") is a count of people who are not coming. Never add it to coming or tell anyone they will have company.

tools.name: activities_offer_choice
tools.description: Let the group choose a time, place, or approved ability field, as the Space owner. Text labels come only from a person on the people page.

tools.name: activities_get_choice
tools.description: Read an activity's current choices and ticks.

tools.name: activities_lock_choice
tools.description: Lock one option of an open activity choice.

tools.name: activities_update
tools.description: Change an activity as its Space owner. Plain text only; an AI may not mark it real.

tools.name: invite_links_create
tools.description: Create a private invite link for a Space. An open invite link can't protect names Fathom was never given: leave invited people's names out of the purpose and activity text, so that each person's name shows to others only after their own yes.

tools.name: experiences_validate
tools.description: Validate a declarative experience manifest.

tools.name: experiences_apply
tools.description: Apply an owner-approved trusted experience manifest.

tools.name: experiences_preview
tools.description: Preview the current trusted experience manifest.

tools.name: activities_tick_choice
tools.description: Tick activity choices only when your person says what works.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fathom_propose, views_propose · Private data: fathom_remember, fathom_space_join, fathom_space, places_verdicts, invite_links_create · Public sink: fathom_propose, fathom_remember · Destructive: genesis_items, views_checks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fathom_propose, views_propose · Private data: fathom_remember, fathom_space_join, fathom_space, places_verdicts, invite_links_create · Public sink: fathom_propose, fathom_remember · Destructive: genesis_items, views_checks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "invite_links_create" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a private invite link for a Space." → after: "Create a private invite link for a Space. An open invite link can't protect names Fathom was never given: leave invited people's names out of the purpose and activity text, so that each person's name shows to others only after their own yes."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
